sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一具女性遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她惨遭斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“简·多伊”（无名氏）。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“案件档案呈现”系列的最新作品，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: It was only 7.30 in the morning, but 35-year-old Eileen Field was already hard at work.
sentences.zh: 当时才早上7点半，35岁的艾琳·菲尔德就已经开始忙碌工作了。

sentences.en: As a stewardess on an ocean liner, her days were kept busy looking after first-class passengers.
sentences.zh: 作为远洋客轮上的空乘，她每天的工作就是照顾头等舱的乘客。

sentences.en: More specifically, Eileen's job was to see to the needs of women staying on the B deck of the Durban Castle.
sentences.zh: 更具体地说，艾琳的工作是照料住在“德班城堡号”B甲板上的女性乘客。

sentences.en: Owned by the Union Castle line, the ship was built in Belfast in 1938.
sentences.zh: 这艘船由联合城堡航运公司拥有，于1938年在贝尔法斯特建造。

sentences.en: When World War II broke out, it was repurposed to carry troops.
sentences.zh: 二战爆发后，它被改作运兵船使用。

sentences.en: But, after the Allies won, it became a commercial ocean liner again.
sentences.zh: 但盟军获胜后，它又恢复了商业客轮的用途。

sentences.en: By 1947, the Durban Castle was sailing regularly from Cape Town in South Africa to the English port of Southampton, ferrying travellers between the two countries.
sentences.zh: 到了1947年，“德班城堡号”定期往返于南非开普敦和英国南安普敦港之间，运送两国间的旅客。

sentences.en: To keep passengers occupied and entertained, there were amenities such as a salon,
sentences.zh: 为了让乘客们有事可做、消磨时光，船上设有沙龙等设施，

sentences.en: a shop, and swimming pools on board, as well as specially organised games, movie nights, and dinner dances.
sentences.zh: 还有商店、游泳池，以及专门组织的各种游戏、电影之夜和晚餐舞会。

sentences.en: As Eileen Field started work on the morning of Saturday October 18, the ship was on the eighth day of its two-week voyage and about 90 miles off the West African coaSt.
sentences.zh: 10月18日星期六清晨，当艾琳·菲尔德开始工作时，这艘船正处于为期两周航程的第八天，距离西非海岸约90英里。

sentences.en: Eileen hurried along a corridor on Durban Castle's B deck towards Cabin 126, which was occupied by a 21-year-old English actress named Eileen Gibson,
sentences.zh: 艾琳沿着“德班城堡号”B甲板的走廊匆匆走向126号客舱，那里住着一位21岁的英国女演员，名叫艾琳·吉布森，

sentences.en: better known by her stage name of Gay Gibson.
sentences.zh: 也就是大家熟知的艺名“盖伊·吉布森”。

sentences.en: It was Eileen's job to wake Gay and bring her some orange juice.
sentences.zh: 艾琳的工作是叫醒盖伊，并给她送去一些橙汁。

sentences.en: Eileen knocked gently on Gay's door.
sentences.zh: 艾琳轻轻敲了敲盖伊的房门。

sentences.en: When there was no answer, she knocked again and called out softly,
sentences.zh: 见无人应答，她又敲了敲，轻声喊道：

sentences.en: Miss Gibson.
sentences.zh: “吉布森小姐。”

sentences.en: There was no reply.
sentences.zh: 依然没有回应。

sentences.en: Eileen decided to try the door handle, even though she knew Gay locked it every night when she went to bed.
sentences.zh: 艾琳决定试着转动门把手，尽管她知道盖伊每晚睡觉前都会反锁房门。

sentences.en: To her surprise, the door opened.
sentences.zh: 令她惊讶的是，门竟然开了。

sentences.en: Gay's cabin was small, with a metal-framed single bed pushed against a wall and a porthole window four and a half feet above the cabin's floor.
sentences.zh: 盖伊的客舱很小，靠墙放着一张金属架单人床，离地四英尺半的地方有一个舷窗。

sentences.en: There was also a built-in wardrobe, a chest of drawers, a bedside light, and two buttons Gay could use to call for a steward or a stewardess.
sentences.zh: 舱内还有一个嵌入式衣柜、一个五斗橱、一盏床头灯，以及两个盖伊可以用来呼叫乘务员的按钮。

sentences.en: The first thing that caught Eileen's eye was the bed.
sentences.zh: 艾琳首先注意到的是那张床。

sentences.en: It was dishevelled and unmade.
sentences.zh: 床铺凌乱，还没整理。

sentences.en: The second was the porthole, which was wide open.
sentences.zh: 其次是舷窗，它敞开着。

sentences.en: Neither of these things were unusual in and of themselves.
sentences.zh: 这两件事本身并不算异常。

sentences.en: However, there was no sign of Gay.
sentences.zh: 然而，盖伊却不见踪影。

sentences.en: Her suitcase was open at the foot of the bed.
sentences.zh: 她的手提箱在床尾敞开着。

sentences.en: The black silk dress she had worn to dinner the previous evening was hanging from a hook at the end of the bed.
sentences.zh: 前一天晚上她穿去吃晚餐的黑色丝绸礼服挂在床头的钩子上。

sentences.en: But Eileen couldn't see Gay's black silk pyjamas or the yellow quilted dressing gown with the zip down the front that she wore over the top of them.
sentences.zh: 但艾琳没看到盖伊的黑色丝绸睡衣，也没看到她穿在睡衣外面的那件带拉链的黄色绗缝晨衣。

sentences.en: Eileen assumed the young woman must have ducked out to the bathroom, still dressed in her nightclothes.
sentences.zh: 艾琳心想，这位年轻女子一定是穿着睡衣去洗手间了。

sentences.en: Strangely though,
sentences.zh: 但奇怪的是，

sentences.en: Gay's slippers sat by the chest of drawers, along with the rest of her shoes.
sentences.zh: 盖伊的拖鞋和她其他的鞋子都放在五斗橱旁边。

sentences.en: Eileen left the glass of orange juice on the top of the chest and left to attend to other duties.
sentences.zh: 艾琳把那杯橙汁放在五斗橱上，便去忙别的工作了。

sentences.en: When she returned in 20 minutes to collect the empty glass, she was surprised to find it full and exactly where she had left it.
sentences.zh: 20分钟后她回来取空杯子时，惊讶地发现杯子还是满的，位置也和她刚才放的一模一样。

sentences.en: There was still no sign of Gay.
sentences.zh: 盖伊依然不见踪影。

sentences.en: And there was something else too.
sentences.zh: 而且还有别的情况。

sentences.en: Looking over at the bed's rumpled sheets,
sentences.zh: 看向床上皱巴巴的床单时，

sentences.en: Eileen noticed several small stains that were the colour of ruSt.
sentences.zh: 艾琳注意到上面有几处锈迹般的小污渍。

sentences.en: The stains on Gay Gibson's bedding struck Eileen Field as very strange.
sentences.zh: 盖伊·吉布森床上的这些污渍让艾琳·菲尔德感到非常奇怪。

sentences.en: In all the time she'd spent tidying the young woman's room, she'd never known her to have soiled sheets.
sentences.zh: 在她打扫这位年轻女子房间的这段时间里，她从未见过床单被弄脏。

sentences.en: After she left Gay's cabin for a second time,
sentences.zh: 第二次离开盖伊的客舱后，

sentences.en: Eileen found a colleague who was responsible for the ship's bathrooms and asked if they'd seen Gay that morning.
sentences.zh: 艾琳找到了一位负责船上洗手间的同事，询问他们那天早上是否见过盖伊。

sentences.en: They hadn't.
sentences.zh: 他们没见过。

sentences.en: Eileen was growing increasingly worried.
sentences.zh: 艾琳越来越担心了。

sentences.en: She had gotten to know the young actress relatively well during the first week of the voyage.
sentences.zh: 在航行的第一周，她和这位年轻女演员相处得还算不错。

sentences.en: Gay was travelling alone to England in the hopes of furthering her stage career.
sentences.zh: 盖伊独自前往英国，希望能进一步发展她的演艺事业。

sentences.en: She hadn't seemed nervous or uneasy about making such a big journey by herself.
sentences.zh: 她看起来并不为独自踏上如此漫长的旅程而感到紧张或不安。

sentences.en: Instead, she struck Eileen as happy, upbeat and healthy.
sentences.zh: 相反，在艾琳眼中，她快乐、乐观且健康。

sentences.en: Someone who was always pleasant to others and never caused any trouble.
sentences.zh: 是一个待人友善、从不惹麻烦的人。

sentences.en: Early on during the trip,
sentences.zh: 在旅程初期，

sentences.en: Gay had confided to Eileen that she was in love with a married man who was back in South Africa.
sentences.zh: 盖伊曾向艾琳吐露，她爱上了一位留在南非的有妇之夫。

sentences.en: But it was her acting career that she seemed most enthusiastic about.
sentences.zh: 但她似乎对自己的演艺事业更为热衷。

sentences.en: Eileen decided to wait a little longer before raising the alarm.
sentences.zh: 艾琳决定再等一会儿才拉响警报。

sentences.en: When Gay failed to show in the dining saloon for breakfast,
sentences.zh: 当盖伊没有出现在餐厅吃早餐时，

sentences.en: Eileen reported her missing.
sentences.zh: 艾琳报告了她失踪的消息。

sentences.en: A search of the ship was undertaken, but Gay wasn't found anywhere.
sentences.zh: 船上进行了搜查，但到处都没找到盖伊。

sentences.en: Fearing that she may have fallen overboard, the ship's captain ordered that the vessel be turned around so the waters could be searched.
sentences.zh: 由于担心她可能落水，船长下令调转船头，以便搜寻海域。

sentences.en: A message was also broadcast over the ship's loudspeakers, asking anyone who knew where Gay might be to immediately report to the purser.
sentences.zh: 船上的广播也发布了消息，要求任何知道盖伊下落的人立即向事务长报告。

sentences.en: Two passengers were particularly alarmed to hear Gay was missing.
sentences.zh: 有两名乘客听到盖伊失踪的消息后格外惊慌。

sentences.en: Frank Hopwood, who worked as a procurement manager for the Union Castle line, and an RAF squadron leader named William Bray, were both in their mid-forties and travelling solo.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克·霍普伍德（联合城堡航运公司的采购经理）和威廉·布雷（英国皇家空军中队长）都四十多岁，独自旅行。

sentences.en: The two men shared the same dining table that Gay was assigned to and had befriended her over the past week.
sentences.zh: 这两位男士和盖伊坐在同一张餐桌，过去一周里与她结下了友谊。

sentences.en: Because Gay was a young woman travelling alone, they saw it as their responsibility to look out for her.
sentences.zh: 因为盖伊是一位独自旅行的年轻女性，他们认为照顾她是自己的责任。

sentences.en: Gay had mentioned how she had heart trouble that prevented her from playing the deck games other passengers took part in.
sentences.zh: 盖伊曾提到她有心脏病，这使她无法参加其他乘客参与的甲板游戏。

sentences.en: Frank also thought she seemed sad and tired at times.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克也觉得她有时看起来很忧郁、很疲惫。

sentences.en: The previous night, Frank and William had escorted Gay to one of the ship's dinner dancers.
sentences.zh: 前一天晚上，弗兰克和威廉还陪同盖伊参加了船上的晚餐舞会。

sentences.en: With just 250 passengers, the ship was less than a third full and Gay was the youngest on board.
sentences.zh: 船上只有250名乘客，载客量不到三分之一，盖伊是船上最年轻的乘客。

sentences.en: Most of the others in first class were aged in their forties or above.
sentences.zh: 头等舱的其他乘客大多在四十岁以上。

sentences.en: The 21-year-old Gay attracted a lot of attention in her black evening gown, silver shoes, and auburn hair worn in a stylish bob.
sentences.zh: 21岁的盖伊身着黑色晚礼服，脚踩银色舞鞋，留着时髦的波波头，吸引了许多目光。

sentences.en: Lots of men asked to dance with her throughout the evening.
sentences.zh: 整个晚上，许多男士都邀请她跳舞。

sentences.en: After leaving the dance,
sentences.zh: 舞会结束后，

sentences.en: Gay sat with Frank and William in the first class smoke room until it closed.
sentences.zh: 盖伊和弗兰克、威廉在头等舱吸烟室一直待到关门。

sentences.en: It was a warm night as the ship sailed along the West African coast, so Gay decided to have a swim in one of the pools.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，船沿着西非海岸航行，天气很暖和，所以盖伊决定去游泳池游个泳。

sentences.en: She went to her cabin to fetch her bathing suit, but couldn't find it.
sentences.zh: 她回客舱去拿泳衣，但没找到。

sentences.en: Disappointed, she rejoined Frank and William on the deck and the trio chatted until 12.40am.
sentences.zh: 失望之下，她回到甲板上与弗兰克和威廉汇合，三人一直聊到凌晨12点40分。

sentences.en: Then Frank escorted Gay to her cabin, wishing her a good night and sweet dreams, before departing.
sentences.zh: 随后，弗兰克护送盖伊回舱，祝她晚安、做个好梦，然后离开。

sentences.en: Her failure to appear at breakfast that morning worried both men.
sentences.zh: 她没能出现在早餐桌上，这让两位男士都很担心。

sentences.en: When they heard the loudspeaker announcement, their concern only grew.
sentences.zh: 当他们听到广播通知时，心中的担忧更甚了。

sentences.en: The captain also radioed other ships in the vicinity, notifying them that a woman was believed to have gone overboard on the Durban Castle
sentences.zh: 船长还通过无线电联系了附近的其他船只，通知他们“德班城堡号”上有一名女子疑似落水，

sentences.en: and asking that they keep a lookout for her.
sentences.zh: 并请求他们帮忙留意。

sentences.en: The ship was steered back and crew members spent about an hour searching the waters for any sign of Gay.
sentences.zh: 船只掉头，船员们花了大约一个小时搜寻海面，寻找盖伊的踪迹。

sentences.en: They found nothing.
sentences.zh: 他们一无所获。

sentences.en: Captain Arthur Patey knew that even if Gay had still been alive when she went overboard, she couldn't survive in the North Atlantic Ocean for that long.
sentences.zh: 亚瑟·佩蒂船长知道，即使盖伊落水时还活着，她也不可能在北大西洋存活那么久。

sentences.en: The water was freezing and home to enormous sharks.
sentences.zh: 海水冰冷刺骨，而且还有巨大的鲨鱼出没。

sentences.en: The elderly woman who occupied the cabin next door to Gay's was asked if she had heard anything suspicious the night before.
sentences.zh: 住在盖伊隔壁的一位老妇人被问及前一天晚上是否听到了什么可疑的声音。

sentences.en: She said she'd been woken in the middle of the night by a crashing sound right outside her door, as though a metal tray had fallen to the ground, but she never heard any voices.
sentences.zh: 她说半夜被门外的一声巨响惊醒，听起来像是金属托盘掉在地上的声音，但她从未听到任何说话声。

sentences.en: It occurred to Captain Patey that perhaps Gay hadn't fallen overboard at all.
sentences.zh: 佩蒂船长想到，也许盖伊根本没有落水。

sentences.en: Maybe she had been the victim of a crime.
sentences.zh: 也许她是犯罪的受害者。

sentences.en: He ordered her cabin locked and set the ship back on course before beginning a rudimentary investigation.
sentences.zh: 他下令锁上她的客舱，在开始初步调查前让船只恢复航向。

sentences.en: One by one, passengers and crew members were summoned to his office to share what they knew about the situation.
sentences.zh: 乘客和船员被逐一传唤到他的办公室，分享他们所知道的情况。

sentences.en: Frank Hopwood and William Bray explained how Gay had retired to her cabin at around 12.40am, but a bosun's mate reported seeing her about 20 minutes later.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克·霍普伍德和威廉·布雷解释说盖伊在凌晨12点40分左右回了舱，但一名水手长报告说20分钟后看到了她。

sentences.en: He had been supervising the swabbing of the decks and noticed Gay standing by a rail, smoking a cigarette and still wearing her evening gown.
sentences.zh: 当时他正在监督甲板清洁工作，注意到盖伊站在栏杆旁抽烟，身上还穿着那件晚礼服。

sentences.en: He warned her that her feet could get wet if she stayed where she was, so she moved along.
sentences.zh: 他提醒她如果一直待在那里脚会被打湿，于是她就走开了。

sentences.en: That hadn't been the last time Gay was sighted.
sentences.zh: 那并不是盖伊最后一次被人看见。

sentences.en: A 39-year-old night watchman named Fred Steer had been on duty the previous night.
sentences.zh: 一位名叫弗雷德·斯蒂尔的39岁夜间巡逻员前一天晚上值班。

sentences.en: At around 3am, he was busy in the first-class pantry when he heard bells ringing for assistance.
sentences.zh: 凌晨3点左右，他在头等舱餐具室忙碌时，听到了求助铃声。

sentences.en: Upon investigating, he saw that both the red and green lights were flashing.
sentences.zh: 调查时，他看到红灯和绿灯都在闪烁。

sentences.en: This indicated that a passenger had pressed two buttons in their cabin.
sentences.zh: 这表明有乘客在客舱内按下了两个按钮。

sentences.en: One to summon a steward and another for a stewardess.
sentences.zh: 一个用来呼叫乘务员，另一个用来呼叫空乘。

sentences.en: Fred was baffled.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德感到困惑。

sentences.en: Usually, a passenger called for just one crew member.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，乘客只会呼叫一名船员。

sentences.en: Requesting two was highly unusual.
sentences.zh: 同时要求两名船员是非常罕见的。

sentences.en: Fred walked along the portside corridor, looking to see which cabin the lights were coming from.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德沿着左舷走廊走去，查看灯光是从哪个客舱发出的。

sentences.en: He followed them to cabin 126, Gay Gibson's cabin.
sentences.zh: 他一路跟到了126号客舱，也就是盖伊·吉布森的房间。

sentences.en: It was located at the end of a small alleyway.
sentences.zh: 它位于一条小巷的尽头。

sentences.en: This section of the ship was sparsely occupied.
sentences.zh: 船上的这一区域人烟稀少。

sentences.en: A woman in her 70s was staying in the cabin next to Gay's, but the other neighbouring rooms were empty.
sentences.zh: 一位70多岁的妇女住在盖伊隔壁，但其他相邻的房间都是空的。

sentences.en: Fred knocked on the door of Gay's cabin.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德敲了敲盖伊的房门。

sentences.en: There was no response.
sentences.zh: 没有回应。

sentences.en: So he carefully tried opening it.
sentences.zh: 于是他小心翼翼地试着打开门。

sentences.en: The door swung inwards, which was strange.
sentences.zh: 门向内打开了，这很奇怪。

sentences.en: Gay always made a point of locking it when she went to bed.
sentences.zh: 盖伊睡觉前总是会特意反锁房门。

sentences.en: It had opened about two inches wide when Fred heard a man's voice say,
sentences.zh: 门开了大约两英寸宽时，弗雷德听到一个男人的声音说：

sentences.en: It's alright.
sentences.zh: “没事的。”

sentences.en: Then the door slammed closed.
sentences.zh: 接着门被猛地关上了。

sentences.en: But, not before Fred caught a glimpse of someone inside.
sentences.zh: 但就在关门前，弗雷德瞥见了里面的人。

sentences.en: A black-haired man had been standing in the darkness, facing the door.
sentences.zh: 一个黑发男人站在黑暗中，面对着门。

sentences.en: Fred recognised him right away.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德一眼就认出了他。

sentences.en: 30-year-old deck steward James Cam had a reputation as a ladies' man.
sentences.zh: 30岁的甲板乘务员詹姆斯·卡姆以“花花公子”著称。

sentences.en: Some of the other crew members nicknamed him Don Jimmy as a play on the name of the infamous womaniser Don Juan.
sentences.zh: 其他一些船员给他起了个绰号叫“唐·吉米”，这是在戏仿臭名昭著的浪子“唐·璜”。

sentences.en: Although Cam had a wife and young daughter back in England, that didn't prevent him from taking a keen interest in the women he served as passengers.
sentences.zh: 虽然卡姆在英国有妻子和年幼的女儿，但这并不妨碍他对服务的女性乘客产生浓厚兴趣。

sentences.en: Described as handsome and charming, Cam had served in the Merchant Navy Reserve during World War II, then joined the Union Castle Fleet in 1946.
sentences.zh: 卡姆被描述为英俊迷人，二战期间曾在商船海军预备役服役，1946年加入联合城堡船队。

sentences.en: He liked the easy tasks of being a deck steward.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢甲板乘务员这种轻松的工作。

sentences.en: His roles included organising games for passengers and serving them food and drinks.
sentences.zh: 他的职责包括为乘客组织游戏，以及为他们提供餐饮服务。

sentences.en: Tips were easy to come by, and the manual labour was minimal.
sentences.zh: 小费很容易拿到，体力劳动也极少。

sentences.en: Multiple crew members had reported seeing Cam take an interest in Gay Gibson.
sentences.zh: 多名船员曾报告说看到卡姆对盖伊·吉布森很感兴趣。

sentences.en: Now, Fred Steer was reporting that he'd seen Cam in Gay's cabin at 3am the night she vanished.
sentences.zh: 现在，弗雷德·斯蒂尔报告说他在盖伊失踪当晚凌晨3点看到了卡姆在她的客舱里。

sentences.en: Deck stewards were not permitted to enter passengers' rooms at any time, let alone in the middle of the night.
sentences.zh: 甲板乘务员在任何时候都不允许进入乘客房间，更不用说在半夜了。

sentences.en: After seeing Cam slam Gay's door shut,
sentences.zh: 看到卡姆猛地关上盖伊的房门后，

sentences.en: Fred hurried back to the pantry and told his superior what had happened.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德匆忙回到餐具室，告诉了他的上司发生了什么事。

sentences.en: The two men walked over to Gay's cabin together and stood outside for about 5 minutes, listening quietly.
sentences.zh: 两人一起走到盖伊的客舱外，静静地听了大约5分钟。

sentences.en: They heard nothing, and there was no sign of Cam.
sentences.zh: 他们什么也没听到，也没看到卡姆的踪影。

sentences.en: Ultimately, it was decided that it wasn't their place to interfere with the passengers' private life, and the matter was left alone.
sentences.zh: 最终，他们决定不便干涉乘客的私生活，这件事就不了了之了。

sentences.en: Upon learning this information, Captain Patey knew that he had to speak with James Cam immediately.
sentences.zh: 得知这些信息后，佩蒂船长知道他必须立即与詹姆斯·卡姆谈谈。

sentences.en: When Cam arrived at the captain's office, Patey wasted no time in asking him,
sentences.zh: 当卡姆来到船长办公室时，佩蒂毫不耽搁地问他：

sentences.en: Do you know why this first-class passenger is missing, Cam?
sentences.zh: “卡姆，你知道这位头等舱乘客为什么失踪吗？”

sentences.en: No, sir, Cam replied.
sentences.zh: “不知道，长官。”卡姆回答道。

sentences.en: Captain Patey kept Fred Steer's sighting to himself, but informed Cam that he was suspected of being near Gay Gibson's cabin.
sentences.zh: 佩蒂船长没有透露弗雷德·斯蒂尔的目击情况，但告知卡姆他被怀疑曾出现在盖伊·吉布森的客舱附近。

sentences.en: Cam adamantly denied this, stating,
sentences.zh: 卡姆坚决否认，声称：

sentences.en: He had gone to bed at 12.45 and didn't leave his room until it was time to get up for work in the morning.
sentences.zh: 他12点45分就上床睡觉了，直到早上起床工作前都没有离开过房间。

sentences.en: Cam did acknowledge that he'd gotten to know Gay quite well over the first week of the voyage.
sentences.zh: 卡姆确实承认他在航行的第一周对盖伊有了相当多的了解。

sentences.en: The pair had chatted from time to time, and Cam said that Gay seemed to show, quote,
sentences.zh: 两人不时聊天，卡姆说盖伊似乎表现出，引用他的话：

sentences.en: a preference for my services, by asking him to deliver drinks to her cabin on several occasions.
sentences.zh: “对我提供的服务情有独钟”，曾多次要求他送饮料到她的客舱。

sentences.en: Two nights earlier, he'd sent a tray with a large glass of rum to her room, but he later noticed that she hadn't touched it.
sentences.zh: 两天前晚上，他曾送去一个托盘，上面有一大杯朗姆酒，但他后来发现她根本没动过。

sentences.en: The next day, he ran into her and teased her about not drinking the rum, saying,
sentences.zh: 第二天，他偶遇她并拿她没喝朗姆酒的事打趣她，说道：

sentences.en: I have a bone to pick with you, and a big one at that.
sentences.zh: 我有一笔账要跟你算，而且是一笔大账。

sentences.en: Somewhat reassured that Cam might be telling the truth,
sentences.zh: 出于对卡姆所言可能属实的些许信任，

sentences.en: Captain Patey asked if he had any reason to believe that Gay might be depressed beneath her outwardly upbeat exterior.
sentences.zh: 佩蒂船长询问他是否有理由相信盖伊在开朗的外表下可能患有抑郁症。

sentences.en: Cam paused, before telling the captain how Gay had mentioned she was in love with a married man back in Johannesburg.
sentences.zh: 卡姆沉默了片刻，随后告诉船长，盖伊曾提到她在约翰内斯堡爱上了一位已婚男士。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 原话是：

sentences.en: She said she was crazy about him and complications had set in.
sentences.zh: 她说她对他爱得疯狂，但情况变得复杂起来。

sentences.en: I asked her, real free-like, I told you she was friendly towards me, what she meant.
sentences.zh: 我当时很随意地问她——我跟你说过她对我挺友好的——问她是什么意思。

sentences.en: She said she suspected she might be going to have a baby.
sentences.zh: 她说她怀疑自己可能怀孕了。

sentences.en: This was not the first time Cam had spoken to a colleague about Gay Gibson being pregnant.
sentences.zh: 这已经不是卡姆第一次向同事提起盖伊·吉布森怀孕的事了。

sentences.en: Stewardess Eileen Field had encountered him in the pantry several days before the young actress disappeared.
sentences.zh: 在年轻女演员失踪前几天，空乘艾琳·菲尔德曾在餐具室遇到过他。

sentences.en: As Eileen handed over a tea tray that she had just collected from Gay's cabin,
sentences.zh: 当艾琳递过一个刚从盖伊客舱收回的茶盘时，

sentences.en: Cam said,
sentences.zh: 卡姆说道：

sentences.en: Miss Gibson is three months pregnant by a married man.
sentences.zh: 吉布森小姐怀了一个已婚男人的孩子，已经三个月了。

sentences.en: Eileen, who didn't believe this for a second, told Cam off for spreading rumours about a female passenger.
sentences.zh: 艾琳根本不信，并斥责卡姆散布关于女乘客的谣言。

sentences.en: He replied that Gay had told him that herself.
sentences.zh: 他回答说这是盖伊亲口告诉他的。

sentences.en: Eileen had strong suspicions that Cam had taken an interest in Gay.
sentences.zh: 艾琳强烈怀疑卡姆对盖伊动了心思。

sentences.en: On one occasion, Eileen found Cam on B deck, the area where Gay's cabin was and where deck stewards were not permitted to be.
sentences.zh: 有一次，艾琳在B层甲板发现了卡姆，那是盖伊客舱所在的区域，而甲板服务员是不允许进入那里的。

sentences.en: When he commented that Gay hadn't had her tea that day,
sentences.zh: 当他评论说盖伊那天没喝茶时，

sentences.en: Eileen responded,
sentences.zh: 艾琳回应道：

sentences.en: If I find you in the vicinity of Miss Gibson's cabin, I will report you to the chief steward.
sentences.zh: 如果我再发现你在吉布森小姐的客舱附近，我就去向总管报告你。

sentences.en: One morning, Eileen collected a tray from Gay's room and saw there were two used teacups.
sentences.zh: 一天早上，艾琳从盖伊的房间收走一个茶盘，看到里面有两个用过的茶杯。

sentences.en: She had no idea who the second cup belonged to.
sentences.zh: 她根本不知道第二个杯子是谁的。

sentences.en: Based on witness accounts, it was clear something had happened to Gay in the very early morning, between the time her cabin's call buttons were pressed at 3am
sentences.zh: 根据证人陈述，很明显盖伊在凌晨出了事，时间就在她客舱呼叫按钮在凌晨3点被按下，

sentences.en: to when Eileen Field attended her cabin at 7.30am.
sentences.zh: 到艾琳·菲尔德早上7点30分去她客舱之间。

sentences.en: When Captain Patey spoke to James Cam's cabin mate, he disagreed with a crucial detail in Cam's version of events.
sentences.zh: 当佩蒂船长与詹姆斯·卡姆的室友谈话时，室友反驳了卡姆叙述中的一个关键细节。

sentences.en: Cam had claimed he was in bed by 12.45am, but his fellow crew member had retired at 1am and Cam was nowhere to be seen.
sentences.zh: 卡姆声称他凌晨12点45分就上床睡觉了，但他的船员同事凌晨1点才休息，当时根本没见到卡姆。

sentences.en: When he was told about this discrepancy,
sentences.zh: 当被告知这一出入时，

sentences.en: Cam changed his story.
sentences.zh: 卡姆改了口。

sentences.en: He'd been working until 1 o'clock and then he went out to a deck where he sat and smoked for a while.
sentences.zh: 他说他一直工作到1点，然后去甲板上坐着抽了会儿烟。

sentences.en: He'd dozed off and when he woke, he went to bed properly.
sentences.zh: 他打了个盹，醒来后才正式去睡觉。

sentences.en: By that time, it was about 2am.
sentences.zh: 那时候大约是凌晨2点。

sentences.en: Despite Cam's firm denials,
sentences.zh: 尽管卡姆坚决否认，

sentences.en: Captain Patey informed him that he was a suspect in Gay's disappearance and would have to be examined by the ship's doctor as a matter of protocol.
sentences.zh: 佩蒂船长还是通知他，他是盖伊失踪案的嫌疑人，按规定必须接受船医检查。

sentences.en: Cam agreed.
sentences.zh: 卡姆同意了。

sentences.en: The doctor had Cam remove his clothes.
sentences.zh: 医生让卡姆脱掉衣服。

sentences.en: He didn't have any bruises or strange marks, but the doctor did notice some light scratches on his left shoulder and wriSt.
sentences.zh: 他身上没有淤青或奇怪的痕迹，但医生确实注意到他的左肩和手腕上有几道浅浅的抓痕。

sentences.en: These looked old, as though they'd been there for a few days.
sentences.zh: 这些看起来是旧伤，好像已经有几天了。

sentences.en: Cam explained that he'd scratched himself due to the humid tropical weather.
sentences.zh: 卡姆解释说是因为热带气候潮湿，他自己抓的。

sentences.en: However, on the back of Cam's neck and on his right forearm were more scratches.
sentences.zh: 然而，在卡姆的后颈和右前臂上还有更多的抓痕。

sentences.en: The ones on his neck were very thin.
sentences.zh: 脖子上的那些非常细。

sentences.en: They didn't look like the work of human fingernails.
sentences.zh: 看起来不像人类指甲抓的。

sentences.en: They looked more like scratches made by a cat.
sentences.zh: 看起来更像是猫抓的。

sentences.en: Cam said they had been left by a particularly rough towel he'd used to dry himself.
sentences.zh: 卡姆说那是他用一条特别粗糙的毛巾擦身时留下的。

sentences.en: The wounds on Cam's arm looked the most suspicious.
sentences.zh: 卡姆手臂上的伤口看起来最可疑。

sentences.en: There were about 12 of them, all about half an inch long and very fresh looking.
sentences.zh: 大约有12处，每处约半英寸长，看起来非常新鲜。

sentences.en: Cam claimed that these two were caused by him scratching himself.
sentences.zh: 卡姆声称这两处也是他自己抓伤的。

sentences.en: Police in England were notified of Gay's disappearance and detectives from Scotland Yard made preparations to board the ship as it approached the UK.
sentences.zh: 英国警方收到了盖伊失踪的通知，苏格兰场的侦探们做好了准备，待船只靠近英国时登船调查。

sentences.en: In the meantime, James Cam resumed his duties.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，詹姆斯·卡姆恢复了工作。

sentences.en: Gay Gibson's cabin was deemed a crime scene.
sentences.zh: 盖伊·吉布森的客舱被定为犯罪现场。

sentences.en: Its porthole was closed and the door padlocked to preserve any evidence inside.
sentences.zh: 舷窗被关上，房门被锁住，以保护里面的任何证据。

sentences.en: Exactly one week after Gay went missing, the Durban Castle anchored off the Isle of Wight and two detectives from Scotland Yard boarded.
sentences.zh: 在盖伊失踪整整一周后，“德班城堡号”在怀特岛附近抛锚，两名苏格兰场侦探登船。

sentences.en: They made their way to cabin 126 to inspect Gay's last known location.
sentences.zh: 他们前往126号客舱，检查盖伊最后出现的地方。

sentences.en: Her belongings lay scattered throughout, including her hairbrush and a book she had been reading.
sentences.zh: 她的物品散落在各处，包括她的发梳和一本她正在读的书。

sentences.en: Five letters of introduction to British theatres and acting agents were discovered stashed in a small leather bag.
sentences.zh: 在一个小皮包里发现了五封给英国剧院和演艺经纪人的介绍信。

sentences.en: In Gay's suitcase, detectives found a tube of spermicidal jelly and a diaphragm which was unused.
sentences.zh: 在盖伊的行李箱里，侦探们发现了一管杀精膏和一个未使用的避孕隔膜。

sentences.en: These two items are used by women as a means to prevent pregnancy.
sentences.zh: 这两样东西是女性用来避孕的。

sentences.en: Once the ship arrived at Southampton, the cabin was dusted for prints.
sentences.zh: 船抵达南安普敦后，客舱进行了指纹采集。

sentences.en: A palm print was discovered on the back of the door.
sentences.zh: 门后发现了一个掌纹。

sentences.en: An examination of the porthole revealed tiny wisps of fabric around its edges.
sentences.zh: 对舷窗的检查显示其边缘有细小的纤维碎屑。

sentences.en: Gay's bedding was removed so the stains could be forensically tested.
sentences.zh: 盖伊的床上用品被取走，以便对污渍进行法医鉴定。

sentences.en: Investigators found urine on the sheets, as well as Type O blood.
sentences.zh: 调查人员在床单上发现了尿液，以及O型血。

sentences.en: James Cam was immediately escorted to Southampton Police Headquarters for a formal interview.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯·卡姆被立即带往南安普敦警察总部接受正式审讯。

sentences.en: For the past week, he'd been maintaining the same story.
sentences.zh: 过去一周，他一直坚持同样的说法。

sentences.en: He'd become friendly with Gay while serving her on board, but he hadn't been to her cabin since the beginning of the trip,
sentences.zh: 他在船上服务时与盖伊变得熟络，但自航程开始后他就没去过她的客舱，

sentences.en: after his crewmates reminded him he wasn't permitted to attend to passengers in their rooMs.
sentences.zh: 因为他的船员同事提醒过他，不允许进入乘客房间提供服务。

sentences.en: Cam was left to wait in an interrogation room for almost 12 hours.
sentences.zh: 卡姆被留在一个审讯室里等待了近12个小时。

sentences.en: Detectives hoped that the time alone would make him anxious and more inclined to confess.
sentences.zh: 侦探们希望这段独处的时间能让他感到焦虑，从而更倾向于招供。

sentences.en: But when they finally went in to speak with him, he continued to deny knowing anything about what happened to Gay.
sentences.zh: 但当他们最终进去找他谈话时，他依然否认知道盖伊发生了什么事。

sentences.en: Finally, after more than an hour of back and forth, a detective remarked,
sentences.zh: 最后，在经过一个多小时的反复交锋后，一名侦探说道：

sentences.en: At that moment, Cam realised that Fred Steer must have recognised him when he opened the cabin door and identified him to investigators.
sentences.zh: 那一刻，卡姆意识到弗雷德·斯蒂尔一定是在他打开舱门时认出了他，并向调查人员指认了他。

sentences.en: Then, he asked a strange question.
sentences.zh: 接着，他问了一个奇怪的问题。

sentences.en: Does this mean I murdered her?
sentences.zh: 这是否意味着我杀了她？

sentences.en: Will I be charged with murder?
sentences.zh: 我会因为谋杀罪被起诉吗？

sentences.en: Cam was informed that it would entirely depend on the circumstances involved, with his interviewing detective stating,
sentences.zh: 卡姆被告知这完全取决于涉及的情况，负责审讯的侦探表示：

sentences.en: You may be able to give a reasonable explanation of the cause of her death, and we will give great consideration to what you say.
sentences.zh: 如果你能对她的死因给出合理的解释，我们会认真考虑你的说法。

sentences.en: There was a long silence.
sentences.zh: 现场陷入了长久的沉默。

sentences.en: Then Cam looked directly at the detective and said,
sentences.zh: 随后，卡姆直视着侦探说道：

sentences.en: I want to tell you something.
sentences.zh: 我想告诉你们一件事。

sentences.en: At 11 on the night of Friday, October 17, Cam decided to ask a gay if she wanted some lemonade with her glass of rum that evening.
sentences.zh: 10月17日星期五晚上11点，卡姆决定问问盖伊那天晚上喝朗姆酒时要不要加点柠檬水。

sentences.en: He found her in her cabin, searching for her bathing suit.
sentences.zh: 他在客舱里找到了她，她正在找泳衣。

sentences.en: He knew he shouldn't be there, but he approached her anyway.
sentences.zh: 他知道自己不该在那儿，但他还是走近了她。

sentences.en: He asked a gay if she'd like some lemonade that night, but she declined.
sentences.zh: 他问盖伊那天晚上要不要喝点柠檬水，但她拒绝了。

sentences.en: Then Cam asked,
sentences.zh: 接着卡姆问：

sentences.en: Do you know what?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: I've got a good mind to get a drink and join you later.
sentences.zh: 我打算待会儿拿杯喝的去找你。

sentences.en: Please yourself, said a gay.
sentences.zh: “随你的便，”盖伊说。

sentences.en: Then she went back upstairs to rejoin her friends.
sentences.zh: 然后她回到楼上继续和朋友们在一起。

sentences.en: As Cam described it, the two had essentially organised the date.
sentences.zh: 按卡姆的说法，两人基本上是约好了。

sentences.en: Cam left the rum outside Gay's cabin.
sentences.zh: 卡姆把朗姆酒留在了盖伊的客舱外。

sentences.en: He returned at around 1am and knocked on the door.
sentences.zh: 他大约凌晨1点回来并敲了敲门。

sentences.en: There was no answer.
sentences.zh: 没人应答。

sentences.en: He left and went back again an hour later.
sentences.zh: 他离开了，一小时后又回来了一次。

sentences.en: This time, Gay answered his knock by inviting him to come in.
sentences.zh: 这一次，盖伊回应了他的敲门声，邀请他进去。

sentences.en: Cam stepped into the cabin, closing the door behind him, but leaving it unlocked.
sentences.zh: 卡姆走进客舱，随手关上门，但没有反锁。

sentences.en: Gay was lying in bed, wearing her yellow quilted dressing gown.
sentences.zh: 盖伊躺在床上，穿着她那件黄色的绗缝睡袍。

sentences.en: The two began to chat.
sentences.zh: 两人开始聊天。

sentences.en: Then Cam climbed into the single bed alongside Gay.
sentences.zh: 随后卡姆爬上了盖伊身边的单人床。

sentences.en: Cam told the investigators that the two started having sex with Gay's consent.
sentences.zh: 卡姆告诉调查人员，两人是在盖伊同意的情况下发生了性关系。

sentences.en: Suddenly, Gay clutched at Cam and froze.
sentences.zh: 突然，盖伊紧紧抓住卡姆，整个人僵住了。

sentences.en: Seconds later, her body fell entirely limp.
sentences.zh: 几秒钟后，她的身体完全瘫软下来。

sentences.en: Her eyes glazed over and there was froth dotted with specks of blood in the corners of her mouth.
sentences.zh: 她的双眼失神，嘴角冒出带有血丝的泡沫。

sentences.en: Terrified, Cam leapt out of bed.
sentences.zh: 卡姆吓坏了，从床上跳了起来。

sentences.en: It looked to him as though Gay had fainted.
sentences.zh: 在他看来，盖伊像是晕倒了。

sentences.en: He began trying to resuscitate her, to no avail.
sentences.zh: 他开始尝试对她进行急救，但无济于事。

sentences.en: Gay remained lifeless.
sentences.zh: 盖伊依然毫无生气。

sentences.en: Then, there was a knock at the door.
sentences.zh: 这时，有人敲门。

sentences.en: It was Fred Steer, responding to the call for a steward and stewardess.
sentences.zh: 是弗雷德·斯蒂尔，他响应了对服务员的呼叫。

sentences.en: Cam had no idea how the call buttons came to be switched on.
sentences.zh: 卡姆根本不知道呼叫按钮是怎么被按下的。

sentences.en: He hadn't pressed them, and he didn't think Gay had either, accidentally or otherwise.
sentences.zh: 他没按过，他也不认为盖伊会按，无论是意外还是其他原因。

sentences.en: Cam slammed the door in Fred's face, then bolted it.
sentences.zh: 卡姆把门在弗雷德面前猛地关上，然后锁死。

sentences.en: Now, he was panicking.
sentences.zh: 现在，他陷入了恐慌。

sentences.en: Somehow, Gay had accidentally died during intercourse, and he would be in trouble when she was found.
sentences.zh: 不知怎的，盖伊在性交过程中意外死亡了，如果她被发现，他会有大麻烦。

sentences.en: His only thought was that he had to get rid of her body.
sentences.zh: 他唯一的念头就是必须处理掉她的尸体。

sentences.en: Cam yanked open the porthole and lifted Gay, who was still wearing her dressing gown.
sentences.zh: 卡姆猛地拉开舷窗，抱起依然穿着睡袍的盖伊，

sentences.en: Then pushed her out of the 42cm diameter opening.
sentences.zh: 然后把她从42厘米直径的开口推了出去。

sentences.en: She fell 25 feet into the Atlantic Ocean below.
sentences.zh: 她坠落了25英尺，掉进了下方的大西洋中。

sentences.en: Then Cam quietly let himself out of the cabin and crept off to his own bed.
sentences.zh: 随后，卡姆悄悄溜出客舱，爬回了自己的床上。

sentences.en: Detectives didn't believe James Cam's story for a second.
sentences.zh: 侦探们根本不相信詹姆斯·卡姆的鬼话。

sentences.en: They were certain he had assaulted and strangled Gay Gibson, then callously disposed of her to cover up his crimes.
sentences.zh: 他们确信他袭击并勒死了盖伊·吉布森，然后冷酷地抛尸以掩盖罪行。

sentences.en: Despite having no body, they made the decision to charge Cam with murder.
sentences.zh: 尽管没有找到尸体，他们还是决定以谋杀罪起诉卡姆。

sentences.en: When informed of the charges against him, he exclaimed,
sentences.zh: 当他被告知所受指控时，他惊呼道：

sentences.en: My God, I didn't think it would be as serious as this.
sentences.zh: 天哪，我没想到事情会这么严重。

sentences.en: Detective Constable Minden Plumley was later asked to have Cam sign the official typewritten version of his statement.
sentences.zh: 警探明登·普拉姆利后来要求卡姆在官方打印的供词上签字。

sentences.en: He paid a visit to Cam in the cell where he was being held, and came back with a shocking story.
sentences.zh: 他去关押卡姆的牢房探视，回来时带回了一个令人震惊的故事。

sentences.en: Apparently, Cam had made a second, more damning confession following some slight prompting.
sentences.zh: 显然，在稍加诱导后，卡姆又做了一份更具定罪意义的供词。

sentences.en: According to Plumley, Cam told him he often visited the cabins of female passengers and said they welcomed the attention.
sentences.zh: 据普拉姆利说，卡姆告诉他，他经常去女乘客的船舱，并称她们很欢迎这种“关照”。

sentences.en: He also admitted to strangling Gay, then added that when he pushed her through the porthole, she made a hell of a splash.
sentences.zh: 他还承认勒死了盖伊，并补充说，当他把她推过舷窗时，她溅起了巨大的水花。

sentences.en: Detectives began building their case for trial.
sentences.zh: 侦探们开始为审判搜集证据。

sentences.en: The palm print recovered from Gay's cabin door was confirmed to belong to James Cam,
sentences.zh: 从盖伊舱门上提取的掌纹被证实属于詹姆斯·卡姆，

sentences.en: but this meant little in the way of forensic evidence as he had admitted to entering her room on multiple occasions.
sentences.zh: 但这在法医证据方面意义不大，因为他已经承认曾多次进入她的房间。

sentences.en: The blood found on Gay's sheets was presumed to be hers, as it was a different type to Cam's.
sentences.zh: 在盖伊床单上发现的血迹被认为是她自己的，因为血型与卡姆的不同。

sentences.en: The best evidence they had was the statement from Cam himself.
sentences.zh: 他们掌握的最有力证据是卡姆本人的供词。

sentences.en: Although he was denying murder, he was a proven liar who only admitted to being in Gay's room on the night in question when he realised a witness had identified him.
sentences.zh: 尽管他否认谋杀，但他已被证明是个骗子，直到意识到有目击者指认他时，才承认在案发当晚去过盖伊的房间。

sentences.en: Detectives were confident that a jury would agree with them and convict Cam.
sentences.zh: 侦探们确信陪审团会同意他们的观点并给卡姆定罪。

sentences.en: The courts moved quickly.
sentences.zh: 法院的行动非常迅速。

sentences.en: Within a month, Cam's committal hearing had already taken place and he was ordered to stand trial for the murder of Gay Gibson.
sentences.zh: 不到一个月，卡姆的预审听证会就已经结束，他被勒令就谋杀盖伊·吉布森一案接受审判。

sentences.en: Cam's defence attorney was Joshua Caswell, a renowned legal mind who had successfully defended dozens of clients.
sentences.zh: 卡姆的辩护律师是约书亚·卡斯韦尔，一位曾成功为数十名客户辩护的著名法律专家。

sentences.en: Caswell was horrified by Cam's decision to throw a young woman's body out into the open sea,
sentences.zh: 卡斯韦尔对卡姆将一名年轻女性的尸体抛入公海的决定感到震惊，

sentences.en: but was inclined to believe his client was innocent of murder.
sentences.zh: 但他倾向于相信他的当事人没有犯下谋杀罪。

sentences.en: If Cam had intended to assault and kill Gay, then why hadn't he locked the cabin door behind him?
sentences.zh: 如果卡姆打算袭击并杀害盖伊，那他为什么不在离开时锁上舱门？

sentences.en: When the night watchman was summoned, he was able to push the door open.
sentences.zh: 当夜班巡视员被叫来时，他能够推开那扇门。

sentences.en: Cam had slammed it shut in response, and only then did he lock it.
sentences.zh: 卡姆当时猛地关上了门，之后才锁上。

sentences.en: There were also significant doubts that Cam's second confession to Detective Constable Minden Plumley had ever been made.
sentences.zh: 对于卡姆向明登·普拉姆利警探所做的第二份供词是否真实存在，也存在重大疑问。

sentences.en: It turned out that the detective had a history of using dubious methods to obtain confessions from suspects.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，这位警探有通过可疑手段从嫌疑人那里获取供词的前科。

sentences.en: Plumley was also suspected of leaking information about the case to the media.
sentences.zh: 普拉姆利还被怀疑向媒体泄露了案件信息。

sentences.en: He quit the police force in January 1948, just a couple of months after working the Gay Gibson case, though he denied his resignation was in any way related to that investigation.
sentences.zh: 他在1948年1月辞去了警察职务，就在处理盖伊·吉布森案仅仅几个月后，尽管他否认辞职与该调查有任何关系。

sentences.en: In order to defend his client, Joshua Caswell decided he would need to look at Gay Gibson's life more closely.
sentences.zh: 为了给当事人辩护，约书亚·卡斯韦尔决定需要更仔细地审视盖伊·吉布森的生活。

sentences.en: During World War II, Gay Gibson enlisted in the female section of the British Army and performed with an acting troupe that staged shows for soldiers.
sentences.zh: 二战期间，盖伊·吉布森加入了英国陆军女子分队，并随一个表演团为士兵演出。

sentences.en: She continued to pursue her acting ambitions after the war, receiving both major and minor roles in various plays.
sentences.zh: 战后她继续追求演艺梦想，在各种戏剧中获得了大大小小的角色。

sentences.en: When her father relocated to Cape Town for work, Gay and her mother decided to join him.
sentences.zh: 当她父亲因工作搬到开普敦时，盖伊和她母亲决定随行。

sentences.en: Gay arrived in South Africa in March 1947, but soon left Cape Town for Johannesburg, as there were more acting opportunities there.
sentences.zh: 盖伊于1947年3月抵达南非，但很快就从开普敦去了约翰内斯堡，因为那里有更多的演艺机会。

sentences.en: By July, she had been given the lead female role in a play called Golden Boy.
sentences.zh: 到了7月，她已经在一部名为《金童》的戏中获得了女主角。

sentences.en: During the weeks and months she spent rehearsing and performing, she came to know some of her fellow cast members very well.
sentences.zh: 在排练和演出的数周和数月里，她与一些剧组成员变得非常熟悉。

sentences.en: James Cam's defence team were eager to find out more about Gay's life in Johannesburg, so they travelled to South Africa to interview people who had known her.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯·卡姆的辩护团队急于了解更多关于盖伊在约翰内斯堡的生活，于是他们前往南非采访了认识她的人。

sentences.en: Doreen Mantle was a young actress who shared a dressing room with Gay during Golden Boy's run.
sentences.zh: 多琳·曼特尔是一位年轻的女演员，在《金童》演出期间与盖伊共用一个化妆间。

sentences.en: She told Cam's attorneys that Gay had been friendly and kind, but somewhat sickly.
sentences.zh: 她告诉卡姆的律师，盖伊为人友好善良，但身体有些虚弱。

sentences.en: She'd seen Gay faint during rehearsals.
sentences.zh: 她曾见过盖伊在排练时晕倒。

sentences.en: The skin around her mouth had turned blue, and saliva had collected in the corners of her lips.
sentences.zh: 她嘴唇周围的皮肤发青，嘴角还流着唾液。

sentences.en: Other witnesses said they had seen similar things.
sentences.zh: 其他证人也表示见过类似的情况。

sentences.en: Gay had fainted at a party, in a car, and while out in public.
sentences.zh: 盖伊曾在聚会上、车里以及公共场合晕倒过。

sentences.en: She was perceived as physically weak, and at times those involved in the production had been worried that she wouldn't be able to perform.
sentences.zh: 她被认为身体虚弱，有时剧组人员甚至担心她无法完成演出。

sentences.en: One actor and the play's producer said she'd told them that she had a chest complaint and suffered from asthma.
sentences.zh: 一位演员和该剧的制作人说，她曾告诉他们她患有胸部疾病，且患有哮喘。

sentences.en: Cold weather was particularly problematic for her.
sentences.zh: 寒冷的天气对她来说尤其成问题。

sentences.en: Some also described Gay as neurotic, highly strong, and prone to emotional outbursts.
sentences.zh: 有些人还形容盖伊神经质、高度紧张，且容易情绪失控。

sentences.en: Sometime in August, Gay spoke with a doctor who was the wife of the play's producer, telling her that her period was two weeks late.
sentences.zh: 8月的某天，盖伊与剧组制作人的妻子（一位医生）谈话，说她的月经推迟了两周。

sentences.en: The doctor reassured her that this didn't mean she was pregnant, and suggested she started using a diaphragm if she was sexually active.
sentences.zh: 医生安慰她说这并不意味着怀孕，并建议如果她有性生活，就开始使用避孕隔膜。

sentences.en: Doreen Mantle claimed that Gay had been romantically involved with a fellow actor named Mike Abel, who was married.
sentences.zh: 多琳·曼特尔声称盖伊与一位名叫迈克·阿贝尔的已婚男演员有恋情。

sentences.en: She'd seen the two arguing at a cast party and said Gay had accused Mike of getting her pregnant.
sentences.zh: 她曾在剧组聚会上看到两人争吵，并说盖伊指责迈克让她怀孕了。

sentences.en: Mike told a different story.
sentences.zh: 迈克的说法则不同。

sentences.en: He said that he and Gay were just friends.
sentences.zh: 他说他和盖伊只是朋友。

sentences.en: She had confided in him that she was pregnant and asked for money so she could travel to England for an abortion, but he couldn't afford to help her.
sentences.zh: 她曾向他吐露自己怀孕了，并借钱去英国堕胎，但他负担不起，无法帮她。

sentences.en: When he asked who the father was, Gay just laughed.
sentences.zh: 当他问孩子父亲是谁时，盖伊只是笑了笑。

sentences.en: The truth of their relationship is unknown.
sentences.zh: 他们关系的真相不得而知。

sentences.en: By the end of the month, Gay had fallen in love with a 33-year-old man named Charles Schwentowski, whose wife was back in England.
sentences.zh: 到月底，盖伊爱上了一位33岁的男子查尔斯·施文托夫斯基，他的妻子还在英国。

sentences.en: He doted on Gay, sending her flowers and buying her clothes.
sentences.zh: 他对盖伊百般呵护，给她送花、买衣服。

sentences.en: After the season of Golden Boy concluded in September, the cast and crew were preparing to take the show to another city when something unexpected happened.
sentences.zh: 9月《金童》演出季结束后，剧组正准备将该剧带到另一个城市，这时发生了意想不到的事情。

sentences.en: Gay wanted to cancel her contract so she could travel back to England and chase her acting dreams on a bigger stage.
sentences.zh: 盖伊想取消合同，以便回到英国，在更大的舞台上追逐她的演艺梦想。

sentences.en: Charles paid for Gay's ticket home on the Durban Castle and she left for Southampton within a matter of weeks.
sentences.zh: 查尔斯为盖伊支付了乘坐“德班城堡号”回家的船票，几周内她就动身前往南安普敦了。

sentences.en: Some have speculated that Gay's abrupt departure wasn't motivated by a career move, but an unplanned pregnancy.
sentences.zh: 有人推测盖伊的突然离开并非出于职业规划，而是因为意外怀孕。

sentences.en: It's been suggested that she needed to get back to England to have an abortion.
sentences.zh: 有人认为她需要回英国堕胎。

sentences.en: But, the letters of introduction found amongst her belongings do point to Gay looking to further her acting dreams upon arriving in the UK.
sentences.zh: 但是，在她行李中发现的介绍信确实表明，盖伊在抵达英国后确实打算继续追求演艺梦想。

sentences.en: In addition to the South African witnesses, the defence found people who said Gay had been unwell during her time in the armed forces.
sentences.zh: 除了南非的证人外，辩方还找到了其他人，他们称盖伊在服役期间身体一直不好。

sentences.en: On one occasion, she was found lying in bed, her back arched as she clutched her chest and gasped for air.
sentences.zh: 有一次，她被发现躺在床上，背部拱起，双手紧抓胸口，大口喘着气。

sentences.en: Her tongue was caught at the back of her throat.
sentences.zh: 她的舌头卡在喉咙后部。

sentences.en: A junior officer assisted Gay by tilting her head forward and an ambulance was called.
sentences.zh: 一名初级军官通过将她的头向前倾来协助盖伊，随后救护车被叫来。

sentences.en: Gay later explained to the officer that she'd had another turn.
sentences.zh: 盖伊后来向该军官解释说她又发作了。

sentences.en: Joshua Caswell was building a theory.
sentences.zh: 约书亚·卡斯韦尔正在构建一种理论。

sentences.en: Gay Gibson had suffered from some sort of heart condition that had caused her to suddenly die during consensual intercourse with Cam.
sentences.zh: 盖伊·吉布森患有某种心脏病，导致她在与卡姆自愿发生性关系时突然死亡。

sentences.en: Doreen Mantle was asked to travel to England so she could be a witness at Cam's trial.
sentences.zh: 多琳·曼特尔被要求前往英国，以便在卡姆的审判中出庭作证。

sentences.en: Although she was eager to help, her father talked her out of doing so.
sentences.zh: 尽管她很想帮忙，但她的父亲劝阻了她。

sentences.en: But Mike Abel agreed to testify, as did a number of others who had seen Gay's bouts of illness.
sentences.zh: 但迈克·阿贝尔同意出庭作证，其他几位见过盖伊发病的人也同意作证。

sentences.en: The trial began at the Great Hall of Winchester Castle on March 18, 1948, exactly five months after Gay Gibson had disappeared.
sentences.zh: 审判于1948年3月18日在温切斯特城堡大厅开始，距离盖伊·吉布森失踪整整五个月。

sentences.en: By now, the case was a media sensation and had been dubbed the porthole murder.
sentences.zh: 此时，该案已成为媒体轰动事件，被称为“舷窗谋杀案”。

sentences.en: A murder trial without a body was a highly unusual turn of events, and the case was made even more notorious by the glamorous status of the victim
sentences.zh: 一场没有尸体的谋杀审判是非常罕见的事件，而受害者迷人的身份使此案更加臭名昭著，

sentences.en: and the scandalous claims being made by the defendant.
sentences.zh: 再加上被告提出的那些令人震惊的说法。

sentences.en: Hundreds of spectators queued for hours for seats in the gallery.
sentences.zh: 数百名观众排了几个小时的队，只为在旁听席上占个位子。

sentences.en: A model of the cabin was constructed to stand in the castle's Great Hall as a prop, complete with a bed, and the porthole.
sentences.zh: 人们建造了一个船舱模型作为法庭大厅的道具，里面配有床和舷窗。

sentences.en: The defence presented their argument that Gay Gibson had died accidentally during a consensual sexual encounter.
sentences.zh: 辩方提出的论点是，盖伊·吉布森是在自愿的性行为中意外死亡的。

sentences.en: They portrayed Gay as a promiscuous young woman who had possibly been pregnant to a married man.
sentences.zh: 他们将盖伊描绘成一个滥交的年轻女性，可能怀了一个已婚男人的孩子。

sentences.en: Their expert witnesses included a doctor who told the court that Cam's story was entirely plausible from a medical point of view.
sentences.zh: 他们的专家证人包括一位医生，他告诉法庭，从医学角度来看，卡姆的故事完全说得通。

sentences.en: The urine and blood on her sheet could have resulted from a natural death, and the defendant's description of the way Gay's body stiffened then fell limp
sentences.zh: 她床单上的尿液和血迹可能是自然死亡的结果，而被告描述的盖伊身体僵硬然后瘫软的过程，

sentences.en: sounded like heart failure precipitated by lung congestion.
sentences.zh: 听起来像是肺部充血引发的心力衰竭。

sentences.en: A forensic pathologist also agreed with this assessment.
sentences.zh: 一位法医病理学家也同意这一评估。

sentences.en: He suggested that Gay might have died from an asthma attack, a brain aneurysm, or some kind of heart disease.
sentences.zh: 他认为盖伊可能是死于哮喘发作、脑动脉瘤或某种心脏病。

sentences.en: The fact that people who knew Gay had testified to seeing her faint and turn blue around the mouth suggested she might have had a heart problem.
sentences.zh: 认识盖伊的人作证说曾看到她晕倒且嘴唇发青，这表明她可能确实有心脏问题。

sentences.en: Additionally, the pathologist didn't think the scratches on Cam's body looked like defensive wounds.
sentences.zh: 此外，病理学家认为卡姆身上的抓痕看起来不像防御性伤口。

sentences.en: The scratches to his forearm looked too high up.
sentences.zh: 他前臂上的抓痕位置太高了。

sentences.en: James Cam took the stand to share his version of events yet again.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯·卡姆出庭再次分享了他的版本。

sentences.en: However, this time he added another detail that he hadn't mentioned before.
sentences.zh: 然而，这次他增加了一个之前未曾提及的细节。

sentences.en: Gay had been naked beneath her dressing gown.
sentences.zh: 盖伊在睡袍下是赤身裸体的。

sentences.en: While steadfastly insisting that he had never knowingly harmed Gay, he acknowledged that his snap decision to dispose of her body through the porthole had been beastly conduct.
sentences.zh: 虽然他坚定地坚持自己从未蓄意伤害盖伊，但他承认自己决定将尸体从舷窗抛出的冲动行为是极其卑劣的。

sentences.en: The prosecution presented the court with an entirely different theory.
sentences.zh: 控方在法庭上提出了一个完全不同的理论。

sentences.en: James Cam had killed Gay Gibson after she rejected his advances.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯·卡姆在盖伊·吉布森拒绝了他的求爱后杀害了她。

sentences.en: During the struggle, she scratched her attacker and pressed the call buttons in her cabin, summoning the night watchman.
sentences.zh: 在挣扎过程中，她抓伤了袭击者并按下了舱内的呼叫按钮，叫来了夜班巡视员。

sentences.en: Terrified his crime would be uncovered, Cam then pushed her either dead or unconscious body through the porthole.
sentences.zh: 卡姆因害怕罪行败露，随后将她已经死亡或昏迷的身体推过了舷窗。

sentences.en: The prosecution pointed to the contraceptive devices that had been recovered from Gay's luggage.
sentences.zh: 控方指出了从盖伊行李中发现的避孕用品。

sentences.en: If she had agreed to have sex with Cam, then why hadn't she made use of these?
sentences.zh: 如果她同意与卡姆发生性关系，那她为什么不使用这些东西？

sentences.en: The fact that Gay's elderly neighbour in the next cabin had heard a crash in the middle of the night suggested there might have been a struggle.
sentences.zh: 盖伊隔壁舱房的老邻居在半夜听到了撞击声，这表明当时可能发生了挣扎。

sentences.en: And if Gay had died of natural causes, then why hadn't Cam just left her in bed before sneaking out of her room?
sentences.zh: 而且，如果盖伊是自然死亡，那卡姆为什么不在溜出房间前把她留在床上？

sentences.en: There would have been no evidence that pointed to him having harmed her.
sentences.zh: 那样就不会有任何证据指向他伤害了她。

sentences.en: Unless her neck was bruised from where Cam had choked her.
sentences.zh: 除非她的脖子上有卡姆掐她时留下的淤青。

sentences.en: Gay's mother, Ellen Gibson, was called to give evidence.
sentences.zh: 盖伊的母亲艾伦·吉布森被传唤出庭作证。

sentences.en: She denied that her daughter had relationships with married men, saying that her only love was her career.
sentences.zh: 她否认女儿与已婚男人有染，称她唯一的爱就是她的事业。

sentences.en: Ellen described Gay as
sentences.zh: 艾伦形容盖伊是

sentences.en: She insisted that Charles Schwentowski was never Gay's lover.
sentences.zh: 她坚称查尔斯·施文托夫斯基绝不是盖伊的情人。

sentences.en: He was just a business acquaintance who was happy to lend Gay some money to finance her acting ambitions.
sentences.zh: 他只是一个商业熟人，很乐意借钱给盖伊以资助她的演艺梦想。

sentences.en: When Cam's attorney asked,
sentences.zh: 当卡姆的律师问到时，

sentences.en: Although numerous other individuals had claimed they'd seen Gay faint and struggled to breathe on occasion,
sentences.zh: 尽管许多其他人声称曾看到盖伊晕倒并偶尔呼吸困难，

sentences.en: Ellen said the only health complaint Gay ever had was an ear infection.
sentences.zh: 艾伦说盖伊唯一的健康问题是耳部感染。

sentences.en: A renowned pathologist presented a different opinion to the defence experts.
sentences.zh: 一位著名的病理学家提出了与辩方专家不同的意见。

sentences.en: He believed the urine on Gay's sheets indicated she had involuntarily wet the bed as she was being choked.
sentences.zh: 他认为盖伊床单上的尿液表明她在被掐住时不由自主地尿了床。

sentences.en: In his professional experience, loss of bladder control was a symptom typically exhibited by victims of strangulation just before they died.
sentences.zh: 根据他的专业经验，失去膀胱控制是勒死受害者在死亡前通常表现出的症状。

sentences.en: It wasn't seen as often in those who suffered heart failure.
sentences.zh: 这在心脏衰竭患者中并不常见。

sentences.en: When their chance came to cross-examine James Cam, the prosecution wasted no time in challenging each and every one of his claiMs.
sentences.zh: 当控方有机会盘问詹姆斯·卡姆时，他们毫不浪费时间，对他的每一项主张都进行了质疑。

sentences.en: They pointed out that he had lied to his fellow crew members and to police for eight days before sharing the story he was now standing by,
sentences.zh: 他们指出，他在分享现在坚持的这个故事之前，曾向同事和警察撒谎了八天，

sentences.en: steadfastly denying he had been with Gay on the night in question.
sentences.zh: 坚决否认在案发当晚与盖伊在一起。

sentences.en: Cam couldn't explain why he'd decided to dispose of Gay's body other than to say he had panicked in the moment.
sentences.zh: 卡姆无法解释他为什么决定处理掉盖伊的尸体，只能说当时他惊慌失措。

sentences.en: He also couldn't answer how the call buttons came to be pushed.
sentences.zh: 他也无法回答呼叫按钮是怎么被按下的。

sentences.en: Then the prosecution honed in on one key factor in particular,
sentences.zh: 随后，控方特别聚焦于一个关键因素，

sentences.en: Gay Gibson's missing belongings.
sentences.zh: 盖伊·吉布森失踪的财物。

sentences.en: Only two items had vanished from Gay's cabin along with her, a pair of black silk pyjamas and the yellow quilted dressing gown she wore over the top of them.
sentences.zh: 盖伊的舱房里只有两样东西随她一起消失了：一套黑色丝绸睡衣和她穿在外面的一件黄色绗缝睡袍。

sentences.en: Cam had made reference to the gown, but never mentioned the pyjamas.
sentences.zh: 卡姆提到了睡袍，但从未提到睡衣。

sentences.en: If Gay had been naked under her gown, as Cam had only just revealed during his testimony, then where were her pyjamas?
sentences.zh: 如果盖伊在睡袍下是赤身裸体的（正如卡姆在作证时刚刚透露的那样），那她的睡衣在哪里？

sentences.en: The prosecution theorised that Gay had been wearing them as per usual, but Cam was unaware of this because she fought him off while wearing her gown fully zipped up.
sentences.zh: 控方推测盖伊像往常一样穿着睡衣，但卡姆不知道这一点，因为她在穿着拉链拉好的睡袍时反抗了他。

sentences.en: He never removed her gown before pushing her through the porthole, so he hadn't realised she was wearing anything underneath.
sentences.zh: 他在把她推过舷窗前从未脱掉她的睡袍，所以他没意识到她里面还穿着衣服。

sentences.en: Perhaps he'd made the split-second decision to tell the court she was naked because it made his story of a planned romantic rendezvous sound more believable.
sentences.zh: 也许他决定告诉法庭她赤身裸体是临时起意，因为这让关于计划好的浪漫幽会的说法听起来更可信。

sentences.en: The trial wrapped up within four days and the jury retired to deliberate.
sentences.zh: 审判在四天内结束，陪审团退庭商议。

sentences.en: Within forty-five minutes, they had reached a verdict.
sentences.zh: 不到四十五分钟，他们就达成了裁决。

sentences.en: James Cam was found guilty of murder.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯·卡姆被判谋杀罪成立。

sentences.en: Shocked gasps were heard from the gallery.
sentences.zh: 旁听席上传来一阵惊呼。

sentences.en: When Cam was asked if he had anything to say, he replied,
sentences.zh: 当被问及是否有话要说时，卡姆回答道：

sentences.en: I was asked at the start of my trial if I were guilty, and I pleaded not guilty.
sentences.zh: 在审判开始时，有人问我是否有罪，我当时回答无罪。

sentences.en: I plead not guilty now.
sentences.zh: 我现在依然坚持无罪。

sentences.en: The judge then sentenced him to death by hanging,
sentences.zh: 法官随后判处他绞刑，

sentences.en: Britain's compulsory punishment for murder at the time.
sentences.zh: 这是当时英国对谋杀罪的强制性惩罚。

sentences.en: But within several weeks of his conviction,
sentences.zh: 但在他被定罪后的几周内，

sentences.en: Cam's fate was thrown into question when the House of Commons passed a motion suspending the death penalty.
sentences.zh: 随着下议院通过一项暂停死刑的动议，卡姆的命运变得扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: A new criminal justice bill had been tabled, which would see capital punishment abolished if passed into law.
sentences.zh: 一项新的刑事司法法案已被提交，如果该法案获得通过，死刑将被废除。

sentences.en: In the meantime, all death row prisoners would receive a reprieve.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，所有死囚都将获得缓刑。

sentences.en: Cam's sentence was commuted to life in prison.
sentences.zh: 卡姆的刑罚被减为终身监禁。

sentences.en: Although Cam had been convicted, people continued to speculate as to whether he was guilty or innocent.
sentences.zh: 尽管卡姆已被定罪，但人们仍在猜测他究竟是有罪还是无辜。

sentences.en: The case was hotly debated in the media, and Gay Gibson's pyjamas were regarded as the vital clue that could solve it once and for all.
sentences.zh: 媒体对该案进行了激烈的辩论，盖伊·吉布森的睡衣被视为解开此案的关键线索。

sentences.en: In May 1948, three months after the trial concluded, a 34-year-old man entered a police station in the town of Cheltenham and announced that he had crucial information to share.
sentences.zh: 1948年5月，即审判结束三个月后，一名34岁的男子走进切尔滕纳姆镇的一家警察局，声称他有重要信息要提供。

sentences.en: A week earlier, the man had been sitting in a pub when he struck up a conversation with a young researcher for the BBC named John Langham.
sentences.zh: 一周前，这名男子在一家酒吧里与一位名叫约翰·兰汉姆的BBC年轻研究员攀谈起来。

sentences.en: The two chatted about the government's recent moratorium on the death penalty, and soon the subject of Gay Gibson and James Cam arose.
sentences.zh: 两人聊到了政府最近暂停死刑的决定，很快就谈到了盖伊·吉布森和詹姆斯·卡姆的话题。

sentences.en: John Langham informed the man that he knew Gay hadn't been wearing the pyjamas when she died, because they were currently in the possession of his dentiSt.
sentences.zh: 约翰·兰汉姆告诉那名男子，他知道盖伊死时并没有穿那件睡衣，因为睡衣现在在他牙医手里。

sentences.en: During a dental appointment, the dentist told Langham how he had been on the same voyage as Gay and occupied the cabin next door to her.
sentences.zh: 在一次看牙时，牙医告诉兰汉姆，他曾和盖伊乘坐同一艘船，而且住在她隔壁的船舱。

sentences.en: The two had become friendly, and Gay paid him a visit the night before her death.
sentences.zh: 两人相处得很融洽，盖伊在去世前一天晚上还去拜访过他。

sentences.en: They had sex, and she left her black pyjamas behind by accident.
sentences.zh: 他们发生了性关系，她不小心把那件黑色睡衣落在了那里。

sentences.en: To prove his story, the dentist showed Langham the pyjamas, but refused to go public, saying that he feared what that would do to his business and personal life.
sentences.zh: 为了证明自己的故事，牙医向兰汉姆展示了那件睡衣，但拒绝公开，称他担心这会影响他的事业和个人生活。

sentences.en: The man told the police he didn't know the dentist's name or address, but suggested they obtain them from Langham.
sentences.zh: 那名男子告诉警察，他不知道牙医的姓名或地址，但建议他们从兰汉姆那里获取。

sentences.en: A detective took down his statement, but thought little of it.
sentences.zh: 一名侦探记录了他的陈述，但并没有太当回事。

sentences.en: This individual was already known to them, and although he could carry on a decent conversation, he was believed to have, quote, some slight mental disorder.
sentences.zh: 此人他们早有耳闻，虽然他谈吐还算正常，但据信他患有“轻微的精神障碍”。

sentences.en: His story wasn't taken too seriously, although John Langham was indeed a researcher at the BBC.
sentences.zh: 他的故事并没有被太当真，尽管约翰·兰汉姆确实是BBC的一名研究员。

sentences.en: In the years that followed, he became a well-known presenter for the broadcaster.
sentences.zh: 在随后的几年里，他成为了一名知名的广播节目主持人。

sentences.en: In 1965, he took his own life at the age of 40.
sentences.zh: 1965年，他在40岁时自杀身亡。

sentences.en: More recently, crime writer Anthony Brown began digging into the Gay Gibson case and decided to investigate the man's story.
sentences.zh: 最近，犯罪作家安东尼·布朗开始深入研究盖伊·吉布森案，并决定调查这个男人的故事。

sentences.en: Through examining passenger records, he discovered that there was, in fact, a 43-year-old dental surgeon travelling alone on the Durban Castle at the same time as Gay Gibson.
sentences.zh: 通过查阅乘客记录，他发现确实有一位43岁的牙科医生在盖伊·吉布森乘坐“德班城堡号”期间独自旅行。

sentences.en: The man's cabin number wasn't available, but Brown concluded it was unlikely he occupied the one next door to Gay, as her only known neighbour was an elderly woman.
sentences.zh: 虽然没有该男子的船舱号码，但布朗断定他不太可能住在盖伊隔壁，因为盖伊已知的唯一邻居是一位老妇人。

sentences.en: Moreover, if Gay had left her pyjamas in another passenger's cabin, then stewardess Eileen Field would have noticed them missing a day earlier.
sentences.zh: 此外，如果盖伊把睡衣落在了其他乘客的船舱里，那么乘务员艾琳·菲尔德应该会提前一天发现睡衣不见了。

sentences.en: If a dentist did indeed claim to have slept with Gay and kept her pyjamas, then it seems probable that he made the story up.
sentences.zh: 如果真有牙医声称与盖伊发生过关系并留下了她的睡衣，那么这个故事很可能是他编造的。

sentences.en: Not long after his conviction,
sentences.zh: 在他被定罪后不久，

sentences.en: James Cam filed an appeal and loSt.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯·卡姆提起了上诉，但败诉了。

sentences.en: It was only then that some new information came to light.
sentences.zh: 直到那时，一些新的信息才浮出水面。

sentences.en: Cam had always been viewed by his fellow crewmates as a ladies' man who saw no problem with cheating on his wife.
sentences.zh: 卡姆在船员同事眼中一直是个风流浪子，认为背着妻子偷情没什么大不了的。

sentences.en: In reality, he was a sexual predator.
sentences.zh: 实际上，他是一个性掠夺者。

sentences.en: In September 1947,
Alice, not her real name, set sail on the Durban Castle.
sentences.zh: 爱丽丝（化名）登上了“德班城堡号”。

sentences.en: Alice was a young nanny who was travelling to South Africa with her employer.
sentences.zh: 爱丽丝是一位年轻的保姆，正随雇主前往南非。

sentences.en: During the voyage, she became friendly with deck steward James Cam.
sentences.zh: 航行期间，她与甲板乘务员詹姆斯·卡姆熟识了。

sentences.en: One day, the two arranged to meet on the ship's promenade deck.
sentences.zh: 一天，两人约定在船上的散步甲板见面。

sentences.en: When Alice arrived,
sentences.zh: 当爱丽丝到达时，

sentences.en: Cam directed her towards a storage cabin as he followed behind, carrying two drinks.
sentences.zh: 卡姆示意她走向一个储物舱，他则拿着两杯饮料跟在后面。

sentences.en: They stepped inside the cabin and Cam locked the door behind them.
sentences.zh: 他们走进船舱，卡姆随手锁上了门。

sentences.en: The pair sat side by side on deck chairs and chatted for a little while.
sentences.zh: 两人并排坐在躺椅上聊了一会儿。

sentences.en: Suddenly,
sentences.zh: 突然，

sentences.en: Cam was looming over Alice.
sentences.zh: 卡姆向爱丽丝逼近。

sentences.en: He said that he wanted to kiss her.
sentences.zh: 他说他想吻她。

sentences.en: Alice refused, then told Cam she had to go.
sentences.zh: 爱丽丝拒绝了，并告诉卡姆她必须走了。

sentences.en: He demanded a kiss before she left, but Alice declined again.
sentences.zh: 他要求她在离开前亲他一下，但爱丽丝再次拒绝了。

sentences.en: The next thing she knew, she was kneeling on the floor.
sentences.zh: 等她反应过来时，她已经跪在地板上了。

sentences.en: The back of her neck was pressed against the deck chair she'd been sitting in moments earlier and her head was being pushed down on its seat.
sentences.zh: 她的后颈被压在刚才坐的躺椅上，头被用力按在椅面上。

sentences.en: Cam was kneeling next to her, one hand clasping the back of her neck, the other gripping her throat.
sentences.zh: 卡姆跪在她旁边，一只手扣住她的后颈，另一只手掐住她的喉咙。

sentences.en: He was strangling her.
sentences.zh: 他在勒她。

sentences.en: Time seemed to rush by as Alice struggled to comprehend what was happening.
sentences.zh: 当爱丽丝努力理解正在发生的事情时，时间仿佛飞逝。

sentences.en: Eventually, Cam stopped and let her go.
sentences.zh: 最终，卡姆停了下来，放开了她。

sentences.en: Alice was distraught.
